choc-v2.name: Kailh Choc V2 · Mini Whale
choc-v2.note: Our original silent tactile Whale, CPG1353S01D02-01. Original PCB holes and 2.2 mm plate seating are preserved. MX-cross caps still need a skirt, dust-collar and stabilizer fit test.

choc-v1.name: Kailh Choc V1 · PG1350
choc-v1.note: PG1350 reference CPG135001D01-16: two-slot Choc caps, not MX-cross caps. Uses the original contacts and new side slots. The roughly 8.0 mm installed stem height is a drawing-based appearance estimate. Verify wide-key stabilizers and full travel.

gateron-heron.name: Gateron LP 3.0 · Grey Heron
gateron-heron.note: KS-33BHB10B050NW-G13. The plate preview lifts 0.3 mm to the specified 2.5 mm seating height. Existing case geometry is retained for comparison; this is not a released Gateron-height case. Check clips, cap skirts, stabilizers and travel.

gateron-silver.name: Gateron LP 3.0 · Silver
gateron-silver.note: KS-33BS10B043NW-Y92B. Same checked V12 contact pattern; 3.5 mm maximum travel. Plate preview lifts 0.3 mm. Case, cap skirts and stabilizers need a separate mechanical fit check. This does not cover every Gateron generation or Silent Red variant.

xvx-bow.name: XVX Skyline R2 · BOW
xvx-bow.note: Black-on-white Skyline-style shine-through caps. Rounded uniform silhouette; 5 mm overall height and socket seating are visual assumptions from the earlier V10 study, not vendor CAD. Check the exact 127-key kit and stabilizer positions.

xvx-wob.name: XVX Skyline R2 · WOB
xvx-wob.note: White-on-black version of the same approximate Skyline silhouette. Translucent legends do not imply even illumination from our ten interstitial LEDs. Dimensions and seating are appearance assumptions.

nsa-coast.name: NuPhy nSA · COAST-inspired
nsa-coast.note: Broad spherical nSA-style tops and COAST Twilight-inspired colours. Approximate 4.6 mm height; exact underside, seating and colourway are not modeled. MX-cross mount is a candidate interface, not proof of Whale or full TKL kit compatibility. Standard dye-sub PBT legends are opaque.

lsa-v2.name: Keychron LSA V2 · sculpted
lsa-v2.note: A sculpted LSA V2 appearance study, with different row heights and angles. Row dimensions, seating and underside are illustrative rather than measured vendor geometry. The set targets Keychron keyboards; check our MX-cross stem, wide-key stabilizers and case clearance before choosing it.

flat.name: ScottoCaps Flat MX · FDM
flat.note: Actual Joe Scotto FDM blank meshes. 6.7 mm overall including the stem; not automatically lower than a 5 mm XVX cap. All required widths are included in the mesh library. Socket, dust collar, stabilizers and print tolerances still need a fit test. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

glass.name: ScottoCaps Glass MX · resin
glass.note: Actual Joe Scotto resin-print MX blank meshes. 5.7 mm from the central socket opening to the top; wide-key stabilizer bosses extend another 0.9 mm. Follow the designer’s resin process. All widths are modeled; physical fit remains unverified. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

mbk-chili.name: MBK Colors · Chili blanks
mbk-chili.note: Two-slot MBK-style spherical blanks. Colors is a 133-cap range intended for broader layouts. The maker advertises full-size coverage, including modifiers and spacebar. The 3.6 mm height, width, dish and engagement here are appearance assumptions; exact stabilizers and fit still need checking.

mbk-glow.name: MBK Legend Glow · white
mbk-glow.note: MBK Glow-style shine-through legends on the Choc two-slot interface. Appearance dimensions are assumed. Existing Glow kits focus on smaller layouts: all widths beyond 1U, 1.5U and 2U are marked as custom/unconfirmed here. Verify kit legends and quantities as well as sizes.

cfx-white.name: Chocfox CFX · white blanks
cfx-white.note: Chosfox specifies a 16.5 × 16.5 × 3.7 mm 1U cap for Choc V1. Dish, socket engagement and wide shapes are approximate. The listed range stops at 2.25U: this board’s 2.75U Shift and 6.25U spacebar are custom placeholders, highlighted in amber.
